default/31706.htm.text: Miki the Cat: Meow, traveler! What brings you to this remote place? Meow~! Do you happen to have a map of this area? Would you sell it to me? Meow! I don't have a map and I've become lost. Meow! If you are going any further, please be careful! Meow! You can get lost! Meow!

Q00032_AnObviousLie/31706-01.html.text: Miki the Cat: Meow~! Did Gentler send anything with you? Oh, I'm late! Meow~!

Q00032_AnObviousLie/31706-03.html.text: Miki the Cat: Meow~! You can find the herb in the stomachs of alligators on Alligator Island . Meow~! Gentler needs 20 of them. Meow~!

Q00032_AnObviousLie/31706-04.html.text: Miki the Cat: What now? Meow~!

Q00032_AnObviousLie/31706-06.html.text: Miki the Cat: See Gentler for your reward. Meow~! Quickly, before he leaves! Meow~!

Q00032_AnObviousLie/31706-02.html.text: Miki the Cat: He did send me the Map! Meow~! Thank you for delivering it. I don't have any Moretti's Herb for him, I lost it while wandering around. I'll tell you where to get some, though. Will you get it for me? I'm sure Gentler will give you a proper reward. You can get them from alligators on A…
